sentences.text: Mera order kahan hai, can you check the status please?
Sir, ye product damaged hai — I want a return.
Haan bhai, wo delivery date confirm kar do.
Can you please batao ki refund kab tak aayega?
I need this by Friday, warna cancel kar dena padega.
Class ka assignment submit karna hai by tomorrow, right?
Excuse me, mera reservation confirm hua ya nahi?
Wait, actually — kal tak deliver ho jayega na? Just confirming.
Thank you, bahut help ho gayi aapki.
Haan bhai, wo order — actually can you check — kal tak deliver ho jayega na?
